mapper.select: SELECT id, title, subtitle, images, description, flash_price_cents, origin_price_cents, stock, sold, limit_per_user, start_time, end_time, status, version, create_time, update_time FROM flash_product WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE flash_product SET stock = stock + #{qty}, sold = sold - #{qty}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{productId}
UPDATE flash_product SET stock = stock - #{qty}, sold = sold + #{qty}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{productId}
UPDATE flash_product SET status = 2, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{productId}
